issues.description: Aufgabe 07 (problem statement) requires a list of the names of all Gemeinden that have a "Freibad" and the names of the respective Freibäder (Gemeinde.name and Schwimmbad.name). The solution file returns internal identifiers (Gemeinde.schluessel and Schwimmbad.id) instead of the requested name columns. This mismatch between the problem specification and the solution will confuse learners about the expected output columns and will make automatic result checks (which expect names) inconsistent with the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem statement by selecting the name fields rather than keys/IDs. For example: SELECT Gemeinde.name AS gemeinde_name, Schwimmbad.name AS freibad_name FROM Gemeinde JOIN Schwimmbad ON Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel WHERE Schwimmbad.art = 'Freibad'; Alternatively, if returning identifiers was intentional, update the problem text to explicitly request the IDs instead of the names.
